description: Labelled cross-document contradiction set. Each item pairs a claim (from the TA6 or written in TA6 register) with a supporting document (title register / EPC / search / planning), and a gold_label: contradict | consistent | neutral. Contradiction detection collapses {consistent, neutral} into 'not-contradict' for scoring. Expanded 12 Aug 2026 (dissertation audit Goal A2) from 27 to 62 items with a dev/test split. Every item now carries claim_source and document_source provenance: real_ta6 (drawn from the genuine signed TA6, free-text fields only -- checkbox answers on this flattened, non-AcroForm PDF are not used as claims, to avoid the exact checkbox-misalignment risk documented in sections 3.2/4.3), real_document:<filename> (verbatim excerpt from one of the six real supporting documents; correctly labelled neutral in every case since these are from unrelated matters -- see 6.6.1), or synthetic_realistic (hand-authored in the same register, following the original 27's established practice, where no matching real document exists in the corpus). Split is fixed before any model scoring against it (A2: 'tune nothing on test').
